units: <cite ref="Chullin 6a:3">Ḥull. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>דמות י׳ וכ׳</he> the effigy of a dove was found on Mount Gerizim which they (the Samaritans) worshipped.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:8">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>הי׳ הזו בשעה שהיא פורחת וכ׳</he> the dove when flying and tired, flaps one wing and flies with the other.
Gen. R. s. 44 (expl. גוזל, Gen. XV, 9) בר י׳ a young dove, (v. infra, a. Targ. Gen. l. c.).—בֶּן י׳, pl. בְּנֵי י׳ pigeons.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:5">Ḥull. I, 5</cite> <he>כשר בתורין פסול בבני י׳</he> what is fit for offering in doves (large size), is a defect in pigeons; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:11">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>פתורא דיונה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00207"><he>יוֹנָס</he></cite>.].—Pl. <he>יוֹנִים</he>, <he>יוֹנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">Snh. III, 3</cite> <he>מפריחי י׳</he> those who let doves fly (betting on them), v. <cite ref="J00211"><he>יוֹנְתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:3">B. Bath. V, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00319"><he>שׁוֹבָךְ</he></cite>.
